original_test_intent: Verify the exact BlueField 3 PCIe function has the specified numeric identity and negotiated speed, width and resulting bandwidth.
original_method: Map BF3 serial/SKU to a stable domain:BDF and root-port path; preserve baseline; collect full lspci numeric inventory and untruncated verbose target output; derive/compare negotiated versus capable link bandwidth using an approved SPEC matrix; retain AER/log evidence.
manual_activity: Platform/network owner supplies the BF3-to-BDF topology and numeric SPEC/bandwidth oracle, approves tools and interprets any link downgrade.
required_inputs: Expected capable and negotiated PCIe generation/width/bandwidth with tolerance
pciutils and approved optional mlxlink/ethtool versions
Protected evidence path and no-clear policy
safety_requirements: Use secure access without embedded password/host-key bypass
Stop on target ambiguity or new PCIe/AER error; no auto-retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lspci is appropriate, but first-device selection, sshpass and head -60 make the command non-authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run full `lspci -Dnn`, then `lspci -D -s <approved-BDF> -nnvvv`; collect approved mlxlink/ethtool only if needed for the declared bandwidth oracle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BF3 device/vendor ID, speed, bandwidth, 10-minute allocations and SPEC comparison are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a serial/SKU/BDF-bound field matrix with full capable/negotiated link data and deterministic bandwidth calculation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves placeholders, rejects heuristic selection and adds complete evidence/error correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic BlueField presence does not prove BF3 target identity or negotiated bandwidth.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only, but topology ambiguity or truncated capability data can create false results.

project_override_considerations: Owner must specify whether bandwidth means theoretical PCIe payload from speed×width or a separate measured throughput and whether mlxlink/ethtool is in scope.
expected_evidence: Full lspci numeric inventory and target verbose output
Capable/negotiated speed and width plus declared bandwidth calculation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek targets the same PCIe information check, but its heuristic selection and truncation are unsafe implementation defects rather than a different test intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if exact BF3 BDF/SKU/SPEC or the bandwidth definition cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row386 Wistron-Networking-00375-V003: provide BF3 serial/SKU→domain:BDF/root-port map, numeric vendor/device/subsystem IDs, capable/negotiated PCIe generation/width and the authoritative bandwidth definition/floor/tolerance; approve any mlxlink/ethtool scope and full no-clear evidence.

review_improvement: Replaces first-device and truncated inspection with a topology-bound numeric PCIe comparison that can distinguish capability from negotiated degradation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A host may expose multiple Mellanox functions, so grep order is not identity. PCIe bandwidth also cannot be judged from a label alone: negotiated generation and lane width must be tied to the exact function and compared with a declared calculation or measurement oracle.
